empty-inhibitors.quote:
switchInhibitors =
        let
          jq = lib.getExe pkgs.jq;
          empty = pkgs.writeText "empty-inhibitors" "{}";
        in
        # bash
        ''
          incoming="''${1-}"
          action="''${2-}"

          case "$action" in
            boot|dry-activate)
              echo "Not checking switch inhibitors (action = $action)"

migrate-dhcpcd.quote:
hcpcd";
          RuntimeDirectory = "dhcpcd";

          ExecStartPre = "+${pkgs.writeShellScript "migrate-dhcpcd" ''
            # migrate from old database directory
            if test -f /var/db/dhcpcd/duid; then
              echo 'migrating DHCP leases from /var/db/dhcpcd to /var/lib/dhcpcd ...'
              mv /var/db/dhcpcd/* -t /var/lib/
